bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 71
rows=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT chat_id,message_id FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE ((chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id=273) OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=18) OR (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1724)) AND state='published' AND pinned=TRUE AND message_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY chat_id,message_thread_id")
count=$(printf '%s\n' "$rows" | wc -l)
test "$count" = 3 || exit 72
printf '%s\n' "$rows" | while IFS='|' read -r chat_id message_id; do
 if "$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" room_public_readback --chat-id "$chat_id" --message-id "$message_id"; then echo USERBOT_PIN_MESSAGE_READBACK=PASS; else echo USERBOT_PIN_MESSAGE_READBACK=NOT_ACCESSIBLE_OR_NOT_VERIFIED; fi
done
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 73
echo USERBOT_EXISTING_SESSION_PROTECTED=PASS
